name: Ditther
summary: Browser image-effects editor with 75+ effects that turn photos and video into dither, halftone, ASCII, pixel art, voxel and LEGO looks.
description: A free, browser-based editor where you stack 75+ creative effects — pixel, dither, ASCII, halftone, distortion, print, retro, color and light — with text, shapes, images, layers and animation to build posters, graphics and motion visuals. Images and video can be exported; free to start with a Pro tier.
contains: 75+ image effects (dither, ASCII, halftone, pixel art, voxel, LEGO …)
effect stacking with text, shapes, layers and animation
free to start, Pro tier available
